visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair styled in high twin buns sits on a teal cushion in a traditional Japanese-style room. She wears a red floral Qipao and holds a black lace fan. Light pours through a large wooden lattice window behind her, showing a lush green garden. (2) A man in an orange shirt and a black bucket hat jumps high on a trampoline against a clear blue sky. A woman in a pink top and white shorts cycles away on a yellow bicycle along a paved path bordered by vibrant green trees and grass. (3) Close-up shots feature slices of colorful cake and a bowl of shaved ice topped with red beans, pearls, and taro balls. The woman is seen in a car making a humorous face at the camera, then inside a retro Japanese dessert shop with vintage clocks and signs. (4) In a clothing store, the woman browses racks of Qipao dresses. A professional stylist uses a yellow tape measure to check her dimensions, then applies makeup and styles her hair. She poses in a red Qipao with a man in a blue traditional shirt. (5) The couple walks through 'Victory Star Village,' posing among blooming pink flowers and traditional buildings. Wide aerial drone shots capture the Pingtung County Citizen Park, showing modern geometric walking bridges over large green water features and industrial concrete ruins. (6) Children are shown splashing in water and jumping on trampolines. A colorful digital graphic appears on screen promoting the 'Pingtung Cool Summer Festival' with a black bear mascot. The woman ends by taking a photo of a green pond with a camera.

These sounds are clearly layered beneath the main vocal track to provide atmospheric depth while maintaining the upbeat pop music rhythm. (4) Frequent 'whoosh' transition sound effects are used to punctuate the rapid visual cuts between locations. The music maintains a constant 4/4 beat throughout. No distortion or clipping is present, despite the high energy and compressed dynamic range. (5) The narrator concludes with a persuasive tone, asking a final question to the audience.
